title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on How to Apply Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Forging or Selling Forged Diplomas and Degree Certificates of Institutions of Higher Learning

articles.content_en:
In order to punish according to law the criminal activities of forging and selling forged diplomas and degree certificates of higher education institutions, the relevant issues concerning the application of law in handling such cases are now interpreted as follows:
For the act of forging the seal of a higher education institution to produce diplomas or degree certificates, the offender shall, in accordance with Article 280(2) of the Criminal Law, be convicted and punished for the crime of forging the seal of a public institution.
Whoever, knowing that diplomas or degree certificates are produced by forging the seal of a higher education institution, sells them, shall be punished as an accomplice to the crime of forging the seal of a public institution.
